questions.questionTextEn:
Consider the following statements -
 1. India has more arable area than China.
 2. The proportion of irrigated area is more in Indian 
 as compared to China.
 3. The average productivity per hectare in India 
 agriculture is higher than that in China.
 How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.questionTextHi:
[विश्व एवं भौतिक भूगोल: UPSC IAS आधिकारिक प्रश्न • I.A.S. (Pre) 2023]
प्रश्न (हिंदी संस्करण): निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए -
 1. भारत has more arable area than चीन.
 2. The proportion of irrigated area is more in Indian 
 as compared to चीन.
 3. The average productivity per hectare in भारत 
 agriculture is higher than that in चीन.
 How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanationEn:
Arable land is a type of land that can be used for growing 
crops. This land is an significant indicator of any country's 
agricultural potential as well as food security.
Significantly, India has about 154.45 million Hectares of as per 
World Bank data 2021. China has about 108.8 Hectares of ar-
able land. Notably, India has more arable land than China. The 
proportion of irrigated area is around 48-49% in India while 
China has the capacity of 41%. So statement 2 is correct.
While talking about the productivity, it can be measured 
by the yield per unit area of land, which is the amount of 
crop produced per hectare/acre. The average productivity 
per hectare in India agriculture is higher than that in China. 
This statement is not correct.

optionsEn:
The total amount of insolation received at the equator 
is roughly about 10 times of that received at the poles.

Infrared rays constitute roughly two-thirds of 
insolation.

Infrared waves are largely absorbed by water vapour 
that is concentrated in the lower atmosphere.
Infrared waves are a part of visible spectrum of electromagnetic waves of solar radiation.
optionsHi:

is roughly about 10 times of that received at the poles.

विकल्प: Infrared rays constitute roughly two-thirds of 
insolation.

that is concentrated in the lower atmosphere.

questions.explanationEn:

face is in short wavelengths. The energy that the earth re-
ceives is referred to as insolation, or incoming solar radia-
tion. Notably, shortwave solar energy can pass through the 
atmosphere quite easily. Before reaching the surface of the 
earth, the incoming solar energy travels through the atmo-
sphere. A large portion of the near-infrared light is absorbed 
by water vapor, ozone, and other gases in the troposphere. 
Due to this reason assertion (c) is true.

Consider the following statements :
 Statement-I
 The soil in tropical rain forests is rich in nutrients.
 Statement-II
 The high temperature and moisture of tropical 
rain forests cause dead organic matter in the soil to 
decompose quickly.
 Which one of the following is correct in respect of the 
above statements?

[विश्व एवं भौतिक भूगोल: UPSC IAS आधिकारिक प्रश्न • I.A.S. (Pre) 2023]

 Statement-I
 The मृदा in tropical rain forests is rich in nutrients.
 Statement-II
 The high temperature and moisture of tropical 
rain forests cause dead organic matter in the मृदा to 
decompose quickly.
 निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक is correct in respect of the 
above statements?
optionsEn:
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and 
Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I

Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct 
and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for 
Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect.
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct.
optionsHi:
दोनों Statement-I और Statement-II are correct और 
Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I

दोनों Statement-I और Statement-II are correct 
और Statement-II is not the correct explanation for 
Statement-I
विकल्प: Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect.
विकल्प: Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct.
questions.explanationEn:
Tropical rainforests have extremely poor soil, in contrast to 
the common misconception that because of the abundance 
of plants, warmth and moisture, the soil must be quite rich. 
Hence statement-I is false. Notably, tropical rainforests 
have higher temperatures and more moisture than the other 
regions, which accelerates the decomposition of dead organic 
matter in the soil and releases nutrients more rapidly.

Consider the following statements :
 1. In the tropical zone, the western sections of the 
 oceans are warmer than the eastern sections owing 
 to the infl uence of trade winds.
 2. In the temperate zone, westerlies make the eastern 
 sections of oceans warmer than the western 
 sections.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi:
[विश्व एवं भौतिक भूगोल: UPSC IAS आधिकारिक प्रश्न • I.A.S. (Pre) 2021]
प्रश्न (हिंदी संस्करण): निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए :
 1. In the tropical zone, the western sections of the 
 oceans are warmer than the eastern sections owing 
 to the infl uence of trade winds.
 2. In the temperate zone, westerlies make the eastern 
 sections of oceans warmer than the western 
 sections.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanationEn:
The direction of trade winds in the tropics is from east to west, 
due to this, when the warm terrestrial wind reaches the ocean 
located to the west of the landmass, it raise the temperature of 
those oceans. In the temperate zone, the westerly wind blows 
from west to east, in which the eastern sections of the oceans 
become more warm. So both the statements are correct.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक उत्तर एवं व्याख्या (I.A.S. (Pre) 2021): सही विकल्प (C) है।
विस्तृत हिंदी विवरण:
The direction of trade winds in the tropics is पूर्व से पश्चिम के क्रम में, 
due to this, when the warm terrestrial wind reaches the ocean 
located to the west of the landmass, it raise the temperature of 
those oceans. In the temperate zone, the westerly wind blows 
पश्चिम से पूर्व के क्रम में, in which the eastern sections of the oceans 
become more warm. So both the statements are correct.

The annual range of temperature in the interior of the 
continents is high as compared to coastal areas. What 
is/are the reason/ reasons?
 (1) Thermal diff erence between land and water. 
 (2) V ariation in altitude between continents and oceans 
 (3) Presence of strong winds in the interior. 
 (4) Heavy rains in the interior as compared to coasts.
 Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.questionTextHi:
[विश्व एवं भौतिक भूगोल: UPSC IAS आधिकारिक प्रश्न • I.A.S. (Pre) 2013]
प्रश्न (हिंदी संस्करण): The annual range of temperature in the interior of the 
continents is high as compared to coastal areas. What 
is/are the reason/ reasons?
 (1) Thermal diff erence between land and water. 
 (2) V ariation in altitude between continents and oceans 
 (3) Presence of strong winds in the interior. 
 (4) Heavy rains in the interior as compared to coasts.
 नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग कर सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.explanationEn:
The reason behind the high annual range of temperature in 
the interior of the continents is the thermal difference between 
the land and water. The land gets heated rapidly through the 
insolation of the sun whereas water gets heated very slowly. 
Due to this, the weather of the coastal areas remains cold 
as compared to the terrestrial regions. Hence, option (a) is 
the correct answer. But other statements given in the codes 
are not true.

Consider the following :
 1. Electromagnetic radiation
 2. Geothermal energy
 3. Gravitational force
 4. Plate Movements
 5. Rotation of Earth
 6. Revolution of the Earth
 Which of the following above are responsible for 
bringing dynamic changes on the surface of the Earth ?
questions.questionTextHi:
[विश्व एवं भौतिक भूगोल: UPSC IAS आधिकारिक प्रश्न • I.A.S. (Pre) 2013]
प्रश्न (हिंदी संस्करण): Consider the following :
 1. Electromagnetic radiation
 2. Geothermal energy
 3. Gravitational force
 4. Plate Movements
 5. Rotation of Earth
 6. Revolution of the Earth
 निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा above are responsible for 
bringing dynamic changes on the surface of the Earth ?
questions.explanationEn:
The dynamic changes on the Earth’s surface are caused by 
endogenic forces. In general, the origin of endogenic force 
is due to thermal asymmetry in the inner part of the Earth 
and compression and expansion of rocks. In addition to these 
electromagnetic radiation, gravitational force, rotation of 
Earth and its revolution functions are also liable for changes 
on the Earth’s surface.

endogenic forces. In general, the origin of endogenic force 
is due to thermal asymmetry in the inner part of the Earth 
and compression and expansion of rocks. In addition to these 
electromagnetic radiation, gravitational force, rotation of 
Earth and its revolution functions are also liable for changes 
on the Earth’s surface.

During a thunderstorm, the thunder in the sky is 
produced by the –
 1. meeting of cumulonimbus clouds in the sky.
 2. lightning that separates the nimbus clouds.
 3. violent upward movement of air and water particles.
 Select the correct answer using the code given below
questions.questionTextHi:
[विश्व एवं भौतिक भूगोल: UPSC IAS आधिकारिक प्रश्न • I.A.S. (Pre) 2013]
प्रश्न (हिंदी संस्करण): During a thunderstorm, the thunder in the sky is 
produced by the –
 1. meeting of cumulonimbus clouds in the sky.
 2. lightning that separates the nimbus clouds.
 3. violent upward movement of air and water particles.
 नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग कर सही उत्तर चुनिए
questions.explanationEn:
During a thunderstorm, thunder is the sound caused by a 
lightning discharge. Lightning heats the air in its path and 
causes a large over-pressure of the air within its channel. The 
channel expands supersonically into the surrounding air as 
a shockwave and creates an acoustic signal that is heard as 
thunder. Hence none of the above options is correct.
